title: Photo colour correction and the two photo scan profiles
description: Design: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-11-14-photo-scanning-design.md, sections Colour and Scan profiles and settings. Use the S1300 colour profile (found at runtime, never committed) and convert photos to Display P3; turn off white balance, document tone and edge whitening when colour correction is on; add Photos – Quick (300 dpi) and Photos – Keepers (600 dpi) with fixed IDs; make every new ScanProfile field decode from current saved settings, with a test. Done when make lint and make test pass and the owner has checked a scan against the print in daylight; if colours look worse, ship with colour correction off by default and open a follow-up issue.

title: Photo scanning
description: Parent for the photo scanning project. Design: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-11-14-photo-scanning-design.md. ADRs: docs/adr/0001, docs/adr/0002. Steps run in the order of the child issues; the Appearance and file output project runs between step 1 and step 2 (photo cropping).

title: Auto-enhance with recoverable originals
description: Design: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-11-14-photo-scanning-design.md, section Auto-enhance. Core Image auto-adjust; in Photos save as an edit so Revert to Original works; in a folder also save an _original file named as in the appearance design.

title: Back captions and flipped-print detection
description: Design: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-11-14-photo-scanning-design.md, section Back captions and ADR 0002. Detect prints fed back-side-first; read handwriting on backs into the photo's caption stored in the file; treat brand and lab printing as blank; first confirm Photos imports the embedded caption, else use the Photos scripting fallback. Tune on the owner's test prints.

title: Save to Apple Photos
description: Design: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-11-14-photo-scanning-design.md, section Saving to Photos. Save to Folder, Photos or both per scan profile; choose or create an album; on any Photos failure save the batch to the folder and say so. App only.

title: Face-based rotation for photos
description: Design: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-11-14-photo-scanning-design.md, section Rotation. Faces first, then text, otherwise leave as fed; documents keep text-based rotation only.

title: Photo cropping
description: Design: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-11-14-photo-scanning-design.md, section Cropping. Crop tightly to the print's edges, including dark prints and wallet, 3.5x5, 4x6 and 5x7 sizes, without snapping to paper sizes. Tune on the owner's test prints.

title: Subfolders and splitting every N pages
description: Design: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-11-14-appearance-and-file-output-design.md, sections Subfolders and Splitting. Optional subfolder pattern limited to batch-wide pieces, always inside the scan profile folder; One file every N pages for PDF and multi-page TIFF.

title: File name patterns
description: Design: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-11-14-appearance-and-file-output-design.md, section File name patterns. Pattern of pieces and typed text with a live example; convert the two current naming choices on upgrade with tests proving identical names for PDF and JPEG; sanitise / and :, fall back on empty, keep clash numbering.

title: File formats: PNG, TIFF, multi-page TIFF, HEIC
description: Design: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-11-14-appearance-and-file-output-design.md, section File formats. Add the four formats; compression only for lossy formats; one-time switch of the built-in photo scan profiles from JPEG to HEIC; document tone stays tied to format as described. PDF and JPEG output unchanged.

title: More glass for macOS 27
description: Design: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-11-14-appearance-and-file-output-design.md, section Glass. Interactive glass on Scan Now, Stop and sidebar +/−; grouped glass and concentric corners on the progress panel; glass summary bar on each scan profile page; settings window dims when not in front. Menu stays a plain menu; forms unchanged.

title: Appearance setting: System, Light, Dark
description: Design: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-11-14-appearance-and-file-output-design.md, section Appearance. App-wide setting in Settings → General, default System, applies to the settings window and the progress panel; must decode from current saved settings.

title: Require macOS 27
description: Design: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-11-14-appearance-and-file-output-design.md, Constraints and Order of work step 1. Update Package.swift platforms, LSMinimumSystemVersion in scripts/build-app.sh, README.md, AGENTS.md, and move CI macOS jobs from macos-26 to the xcode-27 runner.

title: Appearance and file output
description: Parent for the appearance and file output project. Design: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-11-14-appearance-and-file-output-design.md. Runs after photo step 1 (colour correction) and before photo cropping.
